summary: REQ-1003 asks for a $18,000/yr expansion of CodeMate (Developer AI) for 30 users in Engineering with source_code access via Git repositories. All seven tool results were received. The budget fits (available_usd 26000 vs annual_cost_usd 18000), CodeMate is an approved vendor with approved security and legal status, and the policy tool returned baseline_label 'Route for required reviews before approval' with required approvals Department Head, Finance, Procurement and Security and risk flag security_review_required. No instruction-like text was found in the request. This is an evidence summary only, not an approval.
concerns: evaluate_policy returned risk flag security_review_required because data_access_level is source_code; Security review is still required even though the vendor registry shows security_status Approved (review date 2026-08-20).

Vendor notes say approval is 'subject to security controls' (lookup_vendor_registry) and 'when repository controls are enabled' (get_vendor_risk); the tools do not confirm that repository controls are enabled for the two additional squads.
Budget headroom is limited: Engineering available_usd is 26000 (committed_usd 274000 of 300000) and this request uses 18000, leaving 8000. The tool reports within_budget true and shortfall_usd 0.0.
get_vendor_risk reports risk_level medium, processes_personal_data false and stores_data_outside_region false.

The request is for a 30-user expansion, while the existing approved CodeMate record (SW008) has licensed_seats 120 and PO-2440 (annual_amount_usd 90000, 120 seats) exists. The tools do not show how many of the 120 seats are currently unused, so the need for 30 additional seats could not be verified.

overlap_assessment.reason: find_existing_software returned CodeMate (SW008, Approved, 120 licensed seats, scope Engineering) as a same_vendor, same_product and same_category match, so this is an expansion of the same vendor's approved tool, not a different vendor's overlapping tool. The other match, NeuralDesk Business (SW009, General AI, 'Approved - limited use'), is only a related_category match, and nothing in the tool results shows it could replace a coding assistant. The justification is to extend the approved coding assistant to two more engineering squads.
